observations.name: native-workflow-collection
observations.evidence: Native AX listed four title buttons and per-row disclosure menus; actual viewport screenshot saved.

observations.name: bottom-row-menu
observations.evidence: Last workflow disclosure opened Run / Dry Run / Edit entirely within the native 1250x800 viewport.

observations.name: approval-preview-and-exact-source
observations.evidence: Native Preview showed Verification heading; Source showed exact Markdown and both newlines.

observations.name: real-native-approval-write
observations.evidence: Clicked Approve & Run for Write the reviewed note. Pending count changed 3 to 2; fixture file exactly 50 bytes.

observations.name: settings-categories
observations.evidence: General showed language/background controls; Notifications showed notification preferences and sound preview separately.

observations.name: english-native-menus
observations.evidence: Choosing English changed visible renderer text and native Edit/View/Window/Development menus.

observations.name: sound-preview
observations.evidence: Native preview action returned Played Approval notification sound preview; notification checkbox stayed off. Subjective sound quality and OS notification delivery not asserted.

observations.name: native-session-reading
observations.evidence: Session detail occupied full main workspace; tool JSON code rendered with syntax colors; sidebar remained available.

observations.name: quit-and-relaunch-persistence
observations.evidence: Cmd+Q exited app. Reopening same isolated launcher preserved English and pending count 2.

knownIssues.name: settings-aria-live-language
knownIssues.evidence: Immediately after changing language, generated Settings category section aria labels retained Chinese until reload.

limitations: Focused native observations, not full product acceptance.
Bundle uses the real debug host/helper and a compiled isolated launcher, not the distributable release.
Source may change after this snapshot; later evidence must identify its exact version.
